description: This file defines an exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError' within the Twig Sandbox security module, used to handle cases where disallowed functions are invoked in templates.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError
classes.description: An exception class thrown when an unauthorized function is used in a Twig template, extending the base SecurityError class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and the name of the disallowed function.

methods.name: getFunctionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function that was not allowed.
